title: Tasks
intro: Large jobs are split into small independent units, processed in the background: here, or on your paired machines that lend their power.
empty_hint: Add a folder to a library to see the queue at work.
chat_running: Conversation in progress: the GPU is reserved for it
skipped_types: Skipped (no usable text, or type turned off in the settings): {types}
cancel_text: “{title}”: units not processed yet will be dropped. What is already done is kept.
lease_expired: The machine that was computing this unit stopped responding.
pacing_ac: Plugged in: background work runs at full speed, at low priority.
pacing_normal: On battery: background work runs at full speed (setting).
pacing_pause: On battery: background work waits for power to return.
pacing_eco: On battery: background work eased (one unit at a time per resource, breaks between batches, fewer computing threads).
lease_lost: The machines that were computing it disappeared too many times.
no_machine: no machine could take it before the job's deadline (machine off, ComfyUI closed, or a missing model).
no_progress: No machine could finish it: it was handed out too many times.
pause_now: Right now (the computation in progress is lost)
pause_all_after: Whole queue: after the current unit
pause_all_now: Whole queue: right now (the computation in progress is lost)
